{
  "phoneNote": "The hero section repeats the exact same call and directions links already present in the sticky top bar, and the full contact details block is duplicated at the top and bottom of the page.",
  "desktopNote": "The first screen is clean and direct, but lower sections suffer from orphaned elements like the 2+1 service cards and the unfinished-looking 'Vlečna služba' block with a floating 'Gorenjska' label.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Remove the redundant 'Obiščite nas / Delovni čas' section above the footer since those exact details are already prominently displayed in the dark bar below the hero.",
    "Consolidate the two 'Vlečna služba' sections: put the three services in a balanced 3-column row on desktop and remove the sparse, unfinished grey 'Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko' band.",
    "Remove the underlined 'Pokličite nas' and 'Pot do nas' text links from the hero copy, as those exact actions are already in the header and contact bar right next to them."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Both phone and desktop repeat the full address, directions link, and opening hours block twice on the same page (in the dark bar under the hero and again in 'Obiščite nas' above the footer).",
    "On both phone and desktop, the 'Vlečna služba za Gorenjsko' section has a solitary word 'Gorenjska' floating in empty space, looking like an unstyled or broken element."
  ]
}
